notes.title: Check out Death Drive!
notes.notes:

Following our silent announcement of Death Drive, the time has finally come to reveal more about the game. It's our biggest project (like seriously huge) yet and we're very excited to let you know more about the details. 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682330/Death_Drive_A_DeckBuilding_Open_World_Survival_RPG/

Stay safe!

notes.title: Dungeons of Clay Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
It's October 5th, and that means - Dungeons of Clay demo is now available!

We are just 2 weeks away from the early access launch, meanwhile you can check out the demo and see what the game is all about. Be sure to share your impressions, feedback or anything else you might have to say.

Hope you have fun!

notes.title: Danger Gazers Has Launched!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34640232/a4c3228eed877cb00e3b02ababc086a46674f029.png[/img]
[h1]Danger Gazers Has Launched![/h1]

[b]Happy New Year! And the day has finally come.[/b]

Danger Gazers has officially left Early Access, and is ready for the new players who were patiently waiting for the full release! 😉

[img]https://i.imgur.com/teToRWr.gif[/img]

The game has come a long way since it went into Early Access in May 2019. All thanks to your amazing support and feedback! Major changes and even all the minor tweaks have contributed towards the unique experience that the full release has to offer now.

Once again I'd like to thank you for your comments and support, all the bug reports and your patience.

Have fun!

[h1]v1.0 Changes[/h1]
[list][*] Increased bullet speed for the weaker guns.
[*] Increased hero walk speed.
[*] Rebalanced items and guns.
[*] UI improvements.
[*] Added localization.
[*] Added new achievements.
[*] Added the final boss.
[*] Added help book.
[*] Performance optimizations.
[*] Minor tweaks and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Danger Gazers releasing on May 8th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34640232/dee3032606d09943e8f59baacd33038fb28b1653.gif[/img]

Hey guys,

We at ShotX studio are happy to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043150/Danger_Gazers/]Danger Gazers[/url] will be out on the [b]8th of May[/b]. The game that we have been working on so hard during last months.

Early access will be available before full release. Great opportunity to try the game in advance. As well as a PC version, there will be one for Linux users.

Don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

We can't wait till you play and give us your feedback :)

Thank you for your support.
